primitives-colors-sets-surfaces-gray3-pa.doc: Background of panels laid directly on `surfaces/app` (sidebars, cards, toolbars); first layer of the surface stack. Part of the "gray3" surface set (hidden primitive); reach it through `theme/colors/surfaces/panel1`, never bind it directly.

primitives-colors-sets-surfaces-gray3-ov.doc: Background of elements floating above the whole app: dialogs, popovers, menus, tooltips, notifications. Part of the "gray3" surface set (hidden primitive); reach it through `theme/colors/surfaces/overlay`, never bind it directly.

primitives-colors-sets-surfaces-gray3-te.doc: Main text color on every surface of the set. Meets WCAG AAA against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. theme-colors-surfaces-text-muted.doc: Secondary, muted text color on every surface of the set. Meets WCAG AAA where possible and at least WCAG AA. Monochrome icons use it when they should recede. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

theme-colors-surfaces-text-subtle.doc: Faintest text color over `bg`, `bgHover` and `bgSelected`: placeholders, hints and captions. Roughly 3 to 4:1 contrast, below WCAG AA in some roles, so never use it for essential text. Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

theme-colors-surfaces-alternate-row-bg.doc: Background of every second row in tables, lists, trees and property grids. Translucent, so it works on any surface (panel1, panel2, overlay); the row itself has no background. Hover and selected rows use the neutral element backgrounds.

theme-colors-surfaces-link.doc: Text color of inline links and link-style buttons at rest.

theme-colors-surfaces-link-hover.doc: Text color of links while hovered.

theme-colors-surfaces-border.doc: Main border color of components, on any surface or fill: inputs, outlined buttons, toggles, checkboxes and radios. Translucent black (light) / white (dark), so it composites onto whichever background it sits on, colored fills included.

theme-colors-surfaces-border-muted.doc: Muted border color for surfaces and dividers: panels, overlays, cards, tables, separators, the window edge and outlines that should recede. Translucent black (light) / white (dark), so it composites onto whichever background it sits on.

theme-colors-surfaces-text-success.doc: Success text and icons drawn directly on a surface: positive values, success messages, valid-field hints. At least WCAG AA (4.6:1 Light, 10:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on a success fill uses `intents/success/text`. The same in every accent.

theme-colors-surfaces-scrim.doc: Backdrop behind modal overlays (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet): a translucent black layer between the app and the overlay that dims the content below. The same in every accent.

theme-colors-surfaces-text-info.doc: Informational text and icons drawn directly on a surface: outlined info tags, notes, hints that carry information.
